comment: for_each as an LLM tool, subgraph target. The agent exposes `batch_draft_messages` (node_type: for_each) whose embedded target is an inline sub-agent (single llm_call resolving {{task}}). Each row runs the sub-agent in its own isolated child session (Mode B, per-row isolation) — proving for_each composes with subgraph-as-tool, not just plain nodes.

test_payload.prompt: Draft a one-sentence welcome message for each of these new users: Ana, Bruno, Carla.

config.system_message: You draft messages via the `batch_draft_messages` tool. Always use the tool (never answer from memory). Build the `items` array from the user's request — one row per person, each with a `task` string describing what to draft for them. After the tool returns, present the drafted message for each person.

batch_draft_messages.name: batch_draft_messages
batch_draft_messages.description: Run a sub-agent once per row to draft a message, deterministically. Each row's sub-agent call is fully isolated from the others. Provide `items` as an array of rows, each with a `task` string.

items.description: One row per person, each with a `task` describing what to draft.

task.description: The drafting instruction for this row, e.g. 'Write a one-sentence welcome message for Ana.'

config.system_message: Eres un asistente conciso. Resuelve esta tarea y responde en una sola frase: {{task}}
